The following events took place in '''3648 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Notable events==
*The [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] began.<ref name="Time">[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bhoenn]] indicates during the quest "Operation Salvage" that the Taris resettlement project began five years earlier. Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], the Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that is concurrent to "Operation Salvage" is set in [[3643 BBY]].</ref> The ''[[Endar Rebirth]]'' is destroyed over [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], and its crew escapes to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] below.<ref name="Operation Salvage">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Operation Salvage|Taris}}</ref>
*The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wim Nickter]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]] and began his [[Sith training]] at the local [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]].<ref name="Red Harvest1" />
*The [[InterStellar Regulators]] are hired as the police and defense forces of the planet [[Makeb]].<ref name="Regulators">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|The InterStellar Regulators}}</ref>
